entry_condition: Development fixed-dyad formal qualification v0.3 must have status PASS_TO_CONFIRMATORY_CHARACTER_MASK_PREPARATION and all response-firewall values false.

edge_admissibility.valid_sequence_pair: jointly canonical columns >= ceil(0.50 * frozen alignment length)
edge_admissibility.valid_frozen_edge: at least one valid cross-locality sequence pair exists between the two unchanged frozen graph endpoint localities
edge_admissibility.failed_species: drop species and every incident source-target dyad; do not replace, rewire, switch marker, delete selected sequences, or relax threshold

survivor_dyads.definition: Cartesian product of surviving original confirmatory source species and surviving original confirmatory target species
survivor_dyads.focal_relation: continuous symmetric 500-km edge-midpoint co-opportunity G_st, recomputed on unchanged survivor graphs

response_blind_survivor_information_gate.interpretation: design/evaluability failure only; no biological null

exact_survivor_fixed_tst_requalification.estimator: same v0.3 dyad-specific geometry-null centering and least-favourable private-envelope beta_G test
exact_survivor_fixed_tst_requalification.type1_gate: every private-amplitude Wilson 95% upper rejection bound <=0.10

empirical_opening_authorized_only_if: confirmatory canonical-character mask completed under this rule

empirical_once_opened.primary_estimand: beta_G for z(G_st) in exact source FE + target FE + frozen controls model
empirical_once_opened.primary_test: one-sided least-favourable private-envelope Monte Carlo p-value

forbidden: open nucleotide identities before every pre-response gate passes
change 500-km G radius or symmetric coverage definition
threshold G for the primary analysis
change nuisance controls after mask opening
lower the 0.15 survivor information minimum or raise the 0.15 endpoint concentration ceilings
reuse development formal worlds for survivor requalification
select a taxonomic or geographic subgroup after genetic-response opening
